topic: How does the LPF's 25 GHz stopband impact interference mitigation in multi-beam satellite downlink frequency planning?
consensus_response: The 25 GHz stopband limits spatial processing, increasing inter-beam interference (IBI) and degrading signal-to-interference ratio (SIR). Precoding and analog beamforming can mitigate this issue. Antenna array geometry affects spatial processing capabilities, with phased array architectures enabling beamforming to minimize interference.
reference_context: SatCom systems use analog beamforming for interference mitigation, considering factors like Doppler shift and non-uniform beam illumination.
